_comment: Per-task-type prep/response seconds. Config-driven (not hardcoded), matching authoring's task-skill-mapping.json pattern. Only Milestone-1's 3 delivered task types are configured — TimerService fails fast on any other type rather than silently defaulting. VALUES ARE APPROXIMATE PLACEHOLDERS pending official Pearson candidate-handbook sourcing (tracked risk in plan.md); verify before release. The 5 audio-prompt Speaking types below additionally carry preListenSeconds/preRecordSeconds (plans/phat-speaking-dynamic-prep-timing) — their own prepSeconds value stops being consulted once a real audioPromptRef is present (SnapshotPinService computes prepSeconds dynamically as preListenSeconds + real audio duration + preRecordSeconds instead), kept here only as an inert fallback rather than removed.
